title: A return trip in the kidney
hook: Predict where the illustrated process leads.

knows: Living systems move or transform matter and signals.
doesNotKnow: Reabsorption moves selected substances from the nephron tubule back toward the circulation through surrounding capillaries. The diagram omits the intermediate tissue fluid.

misconception: The illustrated process sends matter or signals to the wrong destination.
objective: Explain reabsorption from tubule fluid to blood in this example.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: During renal tubular reabsorption, where does a recovered solute go from the tubule fluid? Reabsorption moves selected substances from the nephron tubule back toward the circulation through surrounding capillaries. The diagram omits the intermediate tissue fluid.
The diagram shows a selected step, not all structures, inputs, products or intermediate events.
